title: was this finished?

items.content: agent_registry.rs: cache agent ids, O(N) tree/archived_tree/subtree/project counts, set_active no-op when unchanged, equivalence tests vs old algorithms
record_loader.rs + subagents.rs + processes.rs: one-pass list rows, last-activity cache keyed by head seq, store reads outside the registry lock, cheap name_agents
event_loop agents.rs + trace.rs: send agent list first on activation/archive, skip trace history for record-less agents, bundle index; update sequence tests
aura-store-db: hot read-path #[instrument] spans at debug level (no per-read span formatting at the default info filter)
Replace the data-dependent probe with a synthetic #[ignore = "benchmark"] test; measure before/after
Review, fmt/clippy/tests for aura-app, aura-store-db, aura-desktop, aura-ui-terminal; report

summary: No, it isn't finished. I've found the causes and one small fix is done. Three engineers are making the main changes now, and none of those are in yet, so creating and archiving are still as slow as before.
